properties.decision:
DECIDED BY DOING IT, 2026-08-05, on `hxm_program`. This is `dec:how-a-session-is-pointed-at-a-design` option (a) — edit config, restart — CARRIED OUT AND VERIFIED, together with the constraint that makes it safe.

⭐ THE RULE THAT MATTERS, AND IT WAS MISSING FROM THE PROCEDURE THIS AGENT SUPPLIED: reflow2 is configured USER-GLOBALLY on this machine (`~/.claude.json` `mcpServers`, `~/.config/opencode/opencode.json`) with a RELATIVE `--graph-path .reflow2/graph`. An absolute project path must go ONLY into PROJECT-SCOPED config — `~/.claude.json` under `projects["/ABS/PATH"].mcpServers.reflow2`, or `claude mcp add reflow2 --scope local`. PUTTING AN ABSOLUTE PATH IN THE GLOBAL ENTRY WOULD POINT EVERY PROJECT ON THE MACHINE AT ONE PROJECT'S GRAPH.

⚠️ AND THAT IS EXACTLY WHAT THIS AGENT'S INSTRUCTIONS WOULD HAVE CAUSED. Asked for "exact instructions", it produced a procedure saying "edit every config that launches reflow2" and listed only REPO-LOCAL paths (`.mcp.json`, `opencode.json`, `.vscode/mcp.json`). THE ERROR WAS IN THE DERIVATION, NOT THE TYPING: the procedure was read out of `tools/reflow2_init.py`, which writes repo-local configs — and `reflow2_init.py` NEVER WRITES `~/.claude.json`, so it does not describe how this machine is actually set up. A generic answer was given to a specific question by reading the installer's INTENT instead of the machine's STATE. The user's own agent caught it and wrote the missing rule.

THE VERIFIED PROCEDURE, as executed: (1) confirm the target store EXISTS and read its `graph.id.json` for the id and label — never point at a missing path, because that mints a new empty graph; (2) add the project-scoped override, changing ONLY `--graph-path` and preserving `--shared` and `--only-if-present`; (3) RESTART THE SESSION — a `/mcp` reconnect is not enough, because the stdio server survives it and project scope is read at session start — then confirm via `ps` that the process start time is after the edit and the command line shows the absolute path; (4) call `design_identity` and check the id and label against step 1, stopping before any write if they disagree.

WHAT THIS AGENT DID NOT KNOW AND SHOULD HAVE: `--only-if-present` EXISTS AND IS ALREADY SHIPPED (`crates/reflow2-mcp/src/main.rs:76`, checked at `main.rs:772` against `latent::design_present`). It is why a graph-less directory only OFFERS `start_design` rather than silently minting. That narrows `dec:no-design-here-never-looked`: the mint is not silent, it needs a yes — but the offer is still made with no mention of the populated graphs one and two directories away, so "one accidental yes later" remains the live path and the finding stands.

⚠️ THE LIMITATION THAT SURVIVES, AND IT IS THE ORIGINAL PROBLEM ONLY PARTLY FIXED: PROJECT SCOPE IS KEYED TO THE DIRECTORY THE SESSION WAS OPENED IN. An override on `/ABS/PATH/TO/PROJECT` does NOTHING for a session opened in a subdirectory. So the fix holds for sessions started at the project root and not otherwise — which is precisely the case that produced the extra graph. The user's stated safety net is a habit rather than a mechanism: `find . -maxdepth 3 -name .reflow2` before minting anything. THAT IS THE ARGUMENT FOR `cap:describe-design-at-path` REMAINING NECESSARY RATHER THAN SUPERSEDED BY THIS.

ALSO NOT COVERED: opencode's global config still resolves the relative path, so an opencode session on a reflow2 project needs its own project-level config with the array-shaped `command` (binary at head).

A NOTE ON THE THREE GRAPHS, since the record should not carry a stale story: the two sim-scoped graphs (`simulated_beamlines`, `HEX`) ARE INTENTIONAL AND STAY. The root `hxm_program` graph — the one this project recorded as the accidental third — has been ADOPTED as the program-level design and is what the override now points at. The accident became the intent, which does not excuse the mint but does mean the lesson is about not minting a FOURTH.
properties.name: DECIDED in the field — a session is pointed at a design by a PROJECT-SCOPED config override, and an absolute path must never enter a global config
properties.rationale:
Recorded because a procedure this agent supplied as a deliverable was wrong in a way that could have repointed every project on the user's machine, and the correction came from the user actually doing it. The failure mode is worth naming precisely: the answer was derived from `reflow2_init.py` — the installer — and presented as a description of a specific machine it does not configure. Reading intent instead of state is the same error made twice earlier the same day (`export_surface`'s published promises, and the one-graph advice given without reading the launcher). Three times in one session makes it a habit rather than a slip.

Recorded as ACCEPTED rather than proposed because it was not a choice offered and taken — it was executed, verified with `design_identity`, and is now the machine's live configuration. `dec:how-a-session-is-pointed-at-a-design` stays open regardless: this settles what to do TODAY, and the per-call graph reference remains the question, made sharper by the surviving limitation that project scope keys on the launch directory.

The `--only-if-present` correction is on the node because it changes how `dec:no-design-here-never-looked` should be read: the mint is not silent. The finding survives, at lower severity, and saying so is better than leaving the earlier node overstating it.
